# Structured quantum exit study

Informed repository study under adopted Issue #37, before diagnostic repair.
The author has read the common lexer/parser and current Reference. No external
model was invoked; exact deployed model and sampling settings are unavailable.
The checked baseline is commit 21c227dfef1bc379c2762de6e6c1ee3119498ed2.
Its production Rust/Lean sources equal the independently green 0a86fe54 commit.
The existing compiler and native binary are reused, not represented as rebuilt
for the new Reference-only commit. These deliberately refused forms and one
ordinary identifier control are bounded conformance probes, not a benchmark,
semantic proof, or new host-language proposal. Initial sources are saved before
checking and retained without repair.
